# COMMON MOVE

## Project
- Name: COMMON MOVE
- Use: city chess and board-game club
- Arrival inscription: COMMON MOVE
- Quiet-zone entrance inscription: Quiet Play
- Zone names: Quiet Play; Club Tables; Welcome and Storage; Circulation
- Quiet Play location: northwest
- Club Tables location: east; teaching and viewing during events
- Welcome and Storage location: near D1

## Existing room
- Coordinate origin: southwest internal corner
- Axes: x east; y north; z above finished floor
- Internal envelope: 12 m east–west × 9 m north–south
- Clear height: 3.3 m
- Internal footprint: 108 square metres
- Column and shaft footprint: 0.52 square metres
- Area available for zone allocation before new partitions: 107.48 square metres
- Retained elements: enclosing walls, D1, D2, W1, W2, C1, S0, P1, P2
- Available additions: internal lightweight partitions

| ID | Element | Position in metres | Dimensions and condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | Main entrance | South wall, x = 1–2.4 | Clear width 1.4 m; height 2.2 m; outward opening |
| D2 | Secondary exit | East wall, y = 1–2.2 | Clear width 1.2 m; height 2.2 m; outward opening |
| W1 | North window | North wall, x = 1–4 | Width 3 m; height 1.8 m; sill z = 0.9 m |
| W2 | North window | North wall, x = 7–10 | Width 3 m; height 1.8 m; sill z = 0.9 m |
| C1 | Structural column | x = 5.8–6.2; y = 4.3–4.7 | 0.4 × 0.4 m; full height |
| S0 | Service shaft | x = 11.4–12; y = 8.4–9 | 0.6 × 0.6 m; full height |
| P1 | Power point | West wall, y = 2; z = 0.3 | Existing outlet location |
| P2 | Power point | East wall, y = 6; z = 0.3 | Existing outlet location |

## Furniture and equipment
| ID | Item | Quantity | Dimensions | Identity or capacity |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| T1 | Retained chess table | 6 | 800 × 800 mm top; 750 mm high | Clear matte oak top; four black square steel legs; two players |
| T2 | Retained folding game table | 3 | 1800 × 900 mm top; 750 mm high; folded envelope 1800 × 900 × 100 mm | Clear matte oak top; black folding steel trestles; six players |
| S1 | Retained game cabinet | 2 | 1200 × 400 × 1800 mm, width × depth × height | #596854 finish; five full-width open shelf bays per cabinet |
| S1-B | Clear shelf bay | 10 total | 1120 × 360 × 320 mm, width × depth × height | Eight game boxes per bay; 40 per cabinet |
| G1 | Game box | 80 | 300 × 300 × 70 mm | Existing game library |
| CH1 | Player chair | 30 | 450 × 500 mm footprint; seat height 450 mm | Movable between daily and event layouts |
| B1 | Bag compartment | 32 | Clear 300 × 400 × 400 mm, width × depth × height | One per visitor or host |
| R1 | Return tray | 1 | 600 × 400 mm | Game return point near storage |
| TR1 | Table parking trolley | 1 | 1900 × 1000 × 1000 mm, length × width × height | Two folded T2 tables stacked horizontally |
| AV1 | Viewing display | 1 | 1600 × 900 mm | Wall-mounted in the eastern social area |

## Operating states
| State | Quiet Play | Club Tables | Hosts | Furniture change |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| Daily | 12 seated players at six T1 tables | 18 seated players at three T2 tables | 2 standing positions | All nine tables in use |
| Event | 12 seated players at six T1 tables | Six seated beginners at one T2; 12 seated spectators facing AV1 | 2 standing positions | Two T2 tables folded onto TR1; 12 chairs become spectator seating |

| Event phase | Time | Activity |
|---|---|---|
| Arrival | 18:30–19:00 | Entry, bag deposit, game issue and seating |
| Teaching | 19:00–19:20 | Six beginners with one host; chess and spectator viewing continue |
| Shared viewing | 19:20–20:30 | Display viewing and hosted discussion; chess continues |
| Returns | 20:30–20:45 | Game returns, bag collection and departure |

- Changeover allowance: 15 minutes; two hosts
- Occupied-chair allowance: 600 mm beyond each seated table edge
- Continuous circulation clear width: at least 1200 mm beyond occupied furniture
- Turning circles: diameter 1500 mm; one at arrival and one beside a club table
- Quiet boundary: full-height lightweight partition with a self-closing door

## Materials and lighting

| WD-01 | Oak | Clear matte finish on retained tabletops and new arrival joinery |
| AC-01 | Wool-felt-faced acoustic panel | 40 mm mineral-wool backing; quiet-side partition lining up to 2400 mm above floor |
| L-01 | Ambient surface-mounted ceiling lights | Ceiling-mounted; separate dimmer labelled L-01 |
| L-02 | Table pendants | Centred above occupied table positions; separate dimmer labelled L-02 |
| L-03 | Cabinet shelf lights | Inside both S1 cabinets; separate switch labelled L-03 |

steps.userMessage:
COMMON MOVE | A city club for chess, board games and shared viewing

We are fitting out an existing ground-floor room for COMMON MOVE. Its internal envelope is 12 m east–west by 9 m north–south, with a clear height of 3.3 m. Coordinates start at the southwest internal corner, with x east, y north and z above the floor. Entrance D1 occupies x = 1–2.4 m on the south wall; exit D2 occupies y = 1–2.2 m on the east wall. Both openings are 2.2 m high and their doors open outward. North windows W1 and W2 occupy x = 1–4 m and x = 7–10 m respectively, each with a 0.9 m sill and 1.8 m opening height. Column C1 occupies x = 5.8–6.2 m, y = 4.3–4.7 m; shaft S0 occupies x = 11.4–12 m, y = 8.4–9 m. Retain this envelope, both doors, both windows, C1, S0 and the power points recorded in the fact sheet. New lightweight partitions are available within it.

The club needs quiet chess in the northwest, teaching and shared viewing to the east, and arrival and game handling near D1. Build a functional and furniture schedule first, then develop these relationships into the interior. Retain six T1 chess tables, three T2 folding game tables and two sage-green S1 game cabinets. Daily sessions seat 12 chess players and 18 board-game players, supported by two hosts. During the weekly event, the 12 chess players stay seated while six beginners learn at one T2 table and 12 spectators watch a wall-mounted display; the other two T2 tables move to a parking trolley. Arrival runs from 18:30 to 19:00, teaching from 19:00 to 19:20, shared viewing from 19:20 to 20:30, and game returns until 20:45. Allow 15 minutes for two hosts to change the social area between layouts. Provide 32 bag compartments and storage for 80 game boxes.

Use a 600 mm occupied-chair allowance beyond each seated table edge, a continuous route at least 1200 mm clear beyond occupied furniture, and 1500 mm turning circles at arrival and a club table. Separate the quiet zone with a full-height lightweight partition and a self-closing door. Carry FL-01 sealed cork flooring, WD-01 clear matte oak and AC-01 wool-felt-faced acoustic panels through the scheme. Print "COMMON MOVE" at arrival and "Quiet Play" at the quiet-zone entrance. Locate three perspective cameras at V1 (2, 1 m), looking toward (3, 7 m); V2 (1, 8 m), looking toward (5, 6 m); and V3 (10, 2 m), looking toward (9, 7 m), all at an eye height of 1.5 m.

Audience: new players, regular members and the two hosts, with the club owner and fit-out team using the work to agree the layout, furniture reuse and event setup.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the room records, retained furniture, operating sequence and material and lighting keys. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable with its proportion, format and stage. existing-room-and-furniture.png records the measured shell and furniture envelopes. retained-club-furniture.png identifies the existing table and cabinet forms and finishes. quiet-chess-session.png provides the atmosphere of a concentrated two-person game. shared-rules-session.png provides the social distances and gestures of a six-person rules explanation.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page functional and furniture schedule covering Quiet Play, Club Tables, Welcome and Storage, and Circulation, with each zone's area, daily and event occupancy, furniture counts and dimensions, and the FL-01, WD-01 and AC-01 material key
2. Two dimensioned furnished plans, one daily and one event, with zone areas, occupied-chair envelopes, the narrowest route widths, two 1500 mm turning circles, camera positions and all retained room features
3. One circulation and changeover diagram tracing arrival, bag deposit, game issue, seating and returns, together with the two hosts' 15-minute movement of two T2 tables to their trolley
4. One teaching and viewing detail sheet with plan and section, the 1800 × 900 mm teaching table, six beginner seats, 12 spectator seats, the host position and a 1600 × 900 mm wall-mounted display
5. One storage elevation and detail sheet locating both S1 cabinets, all 80 game boxes, 32 bag compartments, the return tray and the two-table parking trolley
6. One section through the quiet-zone entrance, from floor to the 3300 mm ceiling, showing the full-height partition, self-closing door, AC-01 panels, table height and lighting mounting heights
7. One coordinated materials and reflected ceiling sheet locating FL-01, WD-01 and AC-01 and the three lighting layers L-01, L-02 and L-03, with their separate controls
8. Three interior perspectives: V1 daily arrival and social play, V2 daily quiet chess, and V3 the event with six beginners and 12 spectators, each captioned with its viewpoint and operating state
9. One arrival and quiet-zone signage sheet with dimensioned elevations for COMMON MOVE and Quiet Play
10. One 10-second interior walkthrough linking arrival, the quiet-zone threshold and the event viewing area
11. One presentation document of at least 8 pages, reusing the schedule, both plans, circulation diagram, details, materials sheet, perspectives and signage, with the daily-to-event furniture change on one paired page

Acceptance:
- The functional and furniture schedule, both furnished plans and presentation repeat identical zone names, zone areas, furniture totals and FL-01, WD-01 and AC-01 codes. Zone areas, including Circulation, total 107.48 square metres before new partition footprints; new partition footprints are separately identified within those allocations.
- Both furnished plans retain the 12 × 9 m room, D1, D2, W1, W2, C1 and S0 at their recorded coordinates. The plans and teaching detail dimension the 600 mm occupied-chair allowance, routes of at least 1200 mm beyond occupied furniture and the two 1500 mm turning circles. Arrival, game handling and spectator access run outside Quiet Play.
- The daily plan seats 12 chess players and 18 board-game players; the event plan and V3 seat 12 chess players, six beginners and 12 spectators, with two host positions. The circulation diagram and paired presentation page account for all six T1 tables, three T2 tables and 30 player chairs through the 15-minute changeover, including two folded T2 tables on the trolley.
- The storage sheet depicts two S1 cabinets holding 40 game boxes each, 32 clear bag compartments of 300 × 400 × 400 mm, a 600 × 400 mm return tray and a 1900 × 1000 × 1000 mm trolley. The plans and perspectives preserve the retained furniture's oak tops, black table legs and #596854 cabinet finish.
- The quiet-zone section and materials and reflected ceiling sheet share the full-height partition, self-closing door and AC-01 wall-panel locations. The ceiling sheet identifies ambient L-01 surface-mounted ceiling lights, L-02 pendants centred over occupied tables and L-03 shelf lighting in both S1 cabinets, each on its own labelled control; these positions carry into the three perspectives and walkthrough.
- The signage sheet, V1 and walkthrough print COMMON MOVE at arrival; the signage sheet, quiet-zone section and V2 print Quiet Play at its entrance. The three perspectives use V1, V2 and V3 as specified, and the 10-second walkthrough and presentation reuse the same shell, partition and furniture arrangements shown in the corresponding plans.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
